qa.overall_assessment: Core sidechain forwarding implementation is correct and well-structured. TypeScript compiles, unit tests pass, CLI builds, web app builds and deploys without errors. However, dev modified 5 additional files beyond the stated scope (sessionProtocolMapper.ts, typesRaw.ts, reducerTracer.ts, sessionProtocol.ts, _all.tsx) which the BA spec explicitly excluded. The extra changes remove the now-unused 'sidechain' envelope type and simplify app-side code, which is arguably the right thing to do, but violates the stated constraints. Full E2E verification of sidechain message rendering in the sidebar was not possible due to lack of active sessions with Agent/Task tool usage in the dev account.

root_cause_verification.rationale: Root cause was that CLI did not forward isSidechain messages from JSONL to the server. The fix adds isSidechain forwarding in both the scanner initialization path (sendExisting=false) and the live scanner callback, matching the existing proven isMeta pattern. The dedup mechanism prevents duplicates. The fake sidechain root was correctly removed since real JSONL messages contain the actual root.

code_quality_findings.issue: Dev modified sessionProtocolMapper.ts despite BA spec explicitly stating it should NOT be changed. Changed 'sidechain' envelope type to 'text' type.
code_quality_findings.recommendation: While the change is arguably correct (removing the unused sidechain envelope type in favor of standard text), it violates the stated constraint. The orchestrator should decide if this is acceptable.

code_quality_findings.issue: Dev removed sessionSidechainEventSchema and its normalization handler from app-side code, violating the constraint 'Must not change any app-side code'.
code_quality_findings.recommendation: The removal is consistent with the sessionProtocolMapper change (sidechain envelope type no longer emitted). However, it changes app behavior and was out of scope.

code_quality_findings.issue: Dev removed CUID-based sidechain ID mapping and isCuid import from reducerTracer, violating scope constraints.
code_quality_findings.recommendation: Assess if the removed logic was ever exercised. Since sidechain messages were never forwarded before this fix, this code may have been dead code.

all_findings.issue: Dev modified 5 files explicitly excluded from scope by BA spec. Changes remove the 'sidechain' envelope type from wire protocol, mapper, normalizer, and reducer. While these changes are arguably correct (the sidechain type was unused/premature and real sidechain messages use standard 'text' envelopes), they violate the stated constraint 'Must not change sessionProtocolMapper.ts or any app-side code'.
all_findings.recommendation: The orchestrator should review and approve these additional changes. They are coherent with the core fix but expand the blast radius beyond what was specified. Particular attention needed for the wire protocol change (sessionProtocol.ts) which affects the shared contract.
